final: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) as invoiced_order_count FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_order_count) as overall_avg FROM gender_counts), above_average AS (SELECT gc.invoiced_order_count, gc.invoiced_order_count - ac.overall_avg as excess FROM gender_counts gc CROSS JOIN average_count ac WHERE gc.invoiced_order_count > ac.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(invoiced_order_count) as avg_count_above_avg_genders, AVG(excess) as avg_excess_over_overall_avg FROM above_average
